items.prompt: The ingestion contract only accepts whole cents. What must happen to input 2.675 before committing an amount?

options.text: Silently print two decimals and treat it as accepted
options.why: Formatting is not permission to alter the financial value.

options.text: Reject it or apply an explicitly authorised conversion policy
options.why: The contract must resolve the excess precision.

options.text: Assume every exchange uses half-even rounding
options.why: Market rules cannot be invented from this teaching example.

options.text: Parse it as a float so rounding disappears
options.why: Binary representation does not resolve the business rule.

items.explanation: Extra precision is a contract boundary. This demonstration of half-even is not blanket permission to round every input.
